note: Reconstructed from the saved results in commit 9ee502e, not from a guess: the run's own record names its url, its text parts, its state list and every part of every root, and this config restates those exactly. `previews` names 0..6 because the mirror snapshot carries two extra example boxes at the end (the site's own navigation and a placeholder block) that our docs page has no counterpart for; roots pair by order, so reading them would misalign every comparison after example 6. `textParts` is `pre` alone, because a line's width follows its command text, set in our own mono font. `states` is `base` alone: the reference's copy button carries hover and focus styling on data-hover/data-focus attributes that react-aria sets, and the census cannot drive the icon swap, so the interactive states belong to the behaviour checks. The button's two icons are a stack of two absolutely-positioned boxes; the reference names neither, so both are addressed by position: the first is the check, hidden at opacity 0 and scale 0.5 (so its rect reads 8x8 against a computed 16px), the second is the copy icon.
